nodes.name: Statement data
nodes.notes: Set Header Auth credential name X-Statement-Key with a strong random value. Set Allowed Origins to https://YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME.github.io (origin only; no repository path).

parameters.content:
## Statement Studio data bridge
1. Webhook: Header Auth credential, name X-Statement-Key. Match its value in the website.
2. Webhook Allowed Origins: your GitHub Pages origin (no repo path), or http://127.0.0.1:4173 for local testing.
3. Select Hostaway OAuth2 credentials on BOTH HTTP nodes (client credentials, token URL https://api.hostaway.com/v1/accessTokens, scope general, authentication Body).
4. Publish/activate, copy PRODUCTION webhook URL into website.

GET only to Hostaway. Checkout + overlapping stays retrieved; cancelled bookings excluded. Manual monthly Airbnb payments belong in the app, not these lifetime finance totals. No guest contact/payment-card data returned.
